description: LiveCase helps educators and learning designers create, inspect, and edit interactive case simulations through ChatGPT. Authors can work with case structure, characters, chapters, conversational content, questions, scoring characteristics, badges, debriefs, supporting files, and images. The plugin works only with cases the signed-in user is authorized to edit. Publishing, changing visibility, transferring ownership, and deleting an entire case remain in the LiveCase web application.
